Help

Is there a separate backend or CMS login? No — this page is the CMS, on the same /insider login as the on-page editor. Two tools, one account:
  • On-page editor — after login, browse the site and click any highlighted text, image or video to edit it inline, then press Save. Best for single headlines, paragraphs and photos.
  • This dashboard — for everything structured: the hero video link, Highlight project cards, the client logo wall, the stats numbers, testimonials, the city list / footer addresses, the Insights blog (cards, order, hiding, cover images, full text) and long-form article text. Those sections render as lists, so they need list-aware forms — exactly what these tabs provide.
Publishing: every Save goes live immediately on the next page load (no rebuild, no deploy). Images/video: use the file pickers next to any image field, or paste a link (https://… works, e.g. Cloudinary). Home vs whole site: Hero, Highlights, Logos, Stats, Testimonials, the city marquee and the 3 home Insights cards appear on the home page; footer addresses, Insights listing edits and article text apply everywhere, including the article pages themselves. Every card links its slug, and slugs always open the real post page.
